root_cause: Changed tenant-bound Powerhouse runtime projections updated domain state but did not invalidate open native pages; old Brain ACK could remount a newer unsaved form.
fix: Original read-only runtime bridge deduplicates unchanged provider results; original page shell updates all registered open read-only pages for exact principal/route and preserves forms. Identity switch closes old content.
prevention_rules: A changed authenticated runtime read model must invalidate native read-only views using the original portal event bus.
Do not discard a DOM-only customer form draft on Brain ACK even when canonical domain says saved.
Never present another page's partial ACK as the current page's confirmed evidence.
Never carry a view across tenant identity switch; verify source response before claiming outcome.
